name: [🌊] Sword League ⚔️
desc:
Open treasure chests to earn loot, level up your power, and challenge powerful bosses in Sword League — a gladiator simulator! Collect the strongest swords, roll legendary loot, and earn gold as you explore new islands. Upgrade your gear, discover new areas, and see if you can become the strongest!

🗡️ Challenge powerful bosses
💎 Collect rare loot
🤑 Grind for gold
🔥 Forge armors to grind offline
🎯 Click to time your hits
🌍 Explore new islands
🏆 Become the strongest gladiator!
👥 PVP with other players!
⚖️ Trade your rare armors and foods!
